audience: Young people in Beni Suef scrolling Facebook/Instagram Reels who love iced drinks and nostalgic cafés
promise: BALACONBAR in Beni Suef mixes old-time charm with a modern iced matcha you want to try today
cta: Come try it — BALACONBAR, Beni Suef (address, hours, phone to be supplied by the owner)
direction: Retro-modern: sepia/paper/Ruqaa «old world» versus saturated matcha green with variable-width Archivo type and directional blur. 120 BPM original jeel-synth score in Hijaz with a maqsum drum pattern. One 9:16 delivery.

assets.rights: Owner photo of the real cup and carton (2026-10-02); client material, not in git
Owner poster; only the rope, wooden seat and logo are reused, its AI cup is replaced by the real cup
Owner storyboard; text-free crops of its AI scene frames used as café atmosphere, never as product proof
Owner vintage board; drink illustrations, man/car and statue crops used as old-world decoration; its spelling BALAKON BAR is never shown
Derived in code from the owner photos (film5/plates.mjs + ffmpeg crops)

sound.note: Synthesised in film5/score.mjs with lib/audio.mjs and lib/sfx.mjs; no samples, no licence needed

creative.viewer: a Beni Suef local scrolling Reels who should want to visit and try the matcha
creative.problem: a heavy nostalgic brand image must feel alive, quick and 2026, not like a vintage slideshow
creative.promise: old-time taste, today's flavour: a café with soul and a drink worth trying
creative.evidence: the real cup, carton and logo from the owner's photos; the café, car and awnings from the owner's own scene art
creative.motif: the balcony-window arch, which opens as a portal and returns as the logo
creative.light: sepia paper and film grain for the old world, saturated green fields and crisp cut-outs for the new
creative.camera: flat graphic compositions plus one real depth scene (the swing) and macro punch-ins
creative.motion: springs with overshoot, variable-width type, directional blur, dotted-eighth card slams, 1/8-note cuts
creative.sound: 120 BPM jeel-synth in Hijaz, maqsum darbuka, tape-rewind into the old world, filter-open drop, stabs on the menu, percussion on the montage, bell chord on the logo
creative.pacing: hook 2 s, old world 2 s, drop at 4 s, one idea per bar, montage 14–16 s, portal 16 s, brand from 20 s
creative.payoff: the old and the new merge into one lock-up: logo, «لحظتك مع الماتشا», Beni Suef
